(2) The company's own press release, surfaced in the one web search that succeeded, is datelined 'Stockholm, Sweden, 12 March 2025' and states that 'the Board of Directors of Northvolt AB today announced that it has filed for bankruptcy in Sweden' — a primary source for both the fact of the Swedish filing and the March 2025 date (Q2–Q4). (3) The release's framing — 'Following an exhaustive effort to explore all available means to secure a viable financial and operational future' — together with the uploaded notice stating the filing came 'after failing to secure new financing for its battery operations' supports the causation element (Q5); contemporaneous reporting of the failed rescue-financing round would close any residual gap. (4) The single refuting item — GLEIF entity status ACTIVE as of 22 Aug 2025 — does not contradict bankruptcy: GLEIF status tracks LEI registration/renewal, not insolvency; a Swedish bankruptcy does not dissolve the legal entity, and LEIs routinely remain ACTIVE during konkurs. (5) The apparent evidentiary void is an artifact of tooling — every null result was an HTTP 432 quota rejection, not a search that found nothing. On this record TRUE is at least as well supported as UNVERIFIABLE; the drift to UNVERIFIABLE rests on misreading GLEIF and treating infrastructure failures as evidentiary silence.

Confirmation that GLEIF ACTIVE status is expected during Swedish bankruptcy (LEI not lapsed; the estate continues as a legal entity), neutralizing the only refuting item in the record.

Conversely, credible evidence that the 12 March 2025 announcement was withdrawn, that no petition was actually filed, or that the filing was by a different namesake or in a different month — would establish FALSE.
